section_summary.extract_value: This section reports multilevel model results examining how exposure to non-body focused and body focused others relates to intuitive eating. Between-persons, greater average exposure to non-body focused others predicted higher intuitive eating and greater exposure to body focused others predicted lower intuitive eating; within-person and lagged analyses showed that increases in exposure to non-body focused others predicted higher intuitive eating on the same day and from the previous day, whereas body-focused exposure generally did not. BMI was tested as a covariate and removed when it was not a significant predictor; Table 2 and Table 3 are referenced for model details. No study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') is mentioned in this section.
